description: A large dark-plumed emu with a pale blue-grey throat stalks across dry, tussocky grassland at dusk under a dramatic amber-lit sky. Distant mountains sit on the horizon, and on the right a small wooden hut with a smoking chimney stands behind a split-rail fence. Foreground has scrubby bushes and rocky, churned earth. The painting is loose, dark and painterly, with no visible text, border or signature.
